title: Numbers / time 3
note: Second half of a1_time_2 · split 2026-08-31 (James: 36-word cap = 3 rounds). Time 2 — days, months, clock words, last/next week, once a week. Split 2026-08-30 (James). Not in/on/at (that is a1_prepositions_time). No V_*. · 2026-08-31 (James): intro pages 1–2 tables → calendar diagrams (week_strip / year_grid). Week strip shades the weekend and tags the real current day; year grid shades by season and rings the current month.

intro.title: last week · next week
intro.note_cz: Bez **the**. příští týden = **next week**, ne *the next week*.

intro.title: once a week · twice a week
You will use these words in
frames: I work once a week. · *Pracuji jednou týdně.*
She comes next week. · *Přijede příští týden.*
I sleep at night. · *Spím v noci.*
intro.note: Days and months take a capital letter in English: **Monday**, **May**.
intro.note_cz: Dny a měsíce s velkým písmenem: Monday, May.
